capabilities.title: Frame a floor from the grids
capabilities.prompt: Place columns at every grid intersection on Level 1 and beams along all grid lines, using the default types. Show me the plan before you change the model.

capabilities.title: Size check overview
capabilities.prompt: List every structural framing type in this model with its count and total length, and point out members that look unusually long for their section.

capabilities.title: Slab from the architecture
capabilities.prompt: Create structural slabs on Level 2 that follow the architectural floor outlines, 200 mm thick, and tell me where the outlines don't close.

capabilities.title: Pile layout
capabilities.prompt: Lay out piles under the raft on the foundation level as a grid at 3 m centres, keeping 1 m from the edge. Ask for the pile type first.

capabilities.title: Transfer structure review
capabilities.prompt: Find columns that don't continue to the level below and list where they land, so I can review the transfer structure.

capabilities.title: Bracing bays
capabilities.prompt: Add X-bracing in the end bays along grid A on all levels, using a hollow section I choose. Ask me for the section first.

capabilities.title: Connection schedule
capabilities.prompt: List the steel connection types available and propose a connection for each beam-to-column joint on Level 3.

capabilities.title: Steel tonnage
capabilities.prompt: Give me the steel takeoff by section and level, with total tonnage, as a table.

capabilities.title: Beam reinforcement
capabilities.prompt: Reinforce the selected beams with 4 bottom bars, 2 top bars and links at 150 mm centres, using the project's bar types. Confirm before modelling.

capabilities.title: Bar bending schedule
capabilities.prompt: Export the bar bending schedule for the reinforcement in the active view to Excel.

capabilities.title: Slab reinforcement plan
capabilities.prompt: Make a 2D reinforcement plan for the selected slab with the office's detail families: top and bottom mesh, and extra bars at openings.

capabilities.title: Quay layout
capabilities.prompt: Model a quay structure along the selected alignment: deck, beams and piles at the spacing I give. Ask me for the cross-section first.

capabilities.title: Fender and bollard check
capabilities.prompt: List the port furniture on the quay with spacing between items, and flag gaps larger than 20 m.

capabilities.title: Design vessel
capabilities.prompt: Set up the design vessel for the berth and check its clearance along the quay line.

capabilities.title: Levels and grids from a sketch
capabilities.prompt: I'll attach a sketch: read it and create the levels and grids it shows, then list what you made.

capabilities.title: Import a CAD plan
capabilities.prompt: Import the attached DWG on Level 1, list its layers, and tell me which ones look like structure.

capabilities.title: Doors and windows
capabilities.prompt: Place the doors and windows from the attached schedule in the walls on Level 1, matching marks to types.

capabilities.title: Sheets for every level
capabilities.prompt: Create a plan view for every level, put each on a new A1 sheet with our title block, and number the sheets S-100 upwards.

capabilities.title: Tag everything in view
capabilities.prompt: Tag all structural columns and beams in the active view that have no tag, and arrange the tags so they don't overlap.

capabilities.title: Dimension the grids
capabilities.prompt: Dimension all grids in the active plan, with an overall string on two sides.

capabilities.title: General notes
capabilities.prompt: Put the general notes on the cover sheet from the attached text, keeping our text style.

capabilities.title: Model health check
capabilities.prompt: Run a model audit and list the top 10 problems with element ids I can click, most important first.

capabilities.title: Clash check
capabilities.prompt: Find clashes between structural framing and ducts in the linked MEP model, grouped by level.

capabilities.title: Missing items
capabilities.prompt: Check the structural model against the architectural one and list columns or walls that seem to be missing.

capabilities.title: Quantities by level
capabilities.prompt: Export concrete volumes by level and element category as a table I can paste into Excel.

capabilities.title: Apply redlines
capabilities.prompt: Here is a marked-up PDF of our sheets. Read the redlines, list the changes for me to approve one by one, apply them with clouds and a new revision, export the revised sheets and tell me what was done and what wasn't.

capabilities.title: Issue a drawing set
capabilities.prompt: Make a new revision for this issue, add it to sheets S-100 to S-120, and export them to PDF in one file.

capabilities.title: Drawing list
capabilities.prompt: Export the drawing list with sheet numbers, names and current revisions.

capabilities.title: BCF for the coordinator
capabilities.prompt: Export the open clashes as a BCF file for the coordination meeting.

capabilities.title: Embodied carbon now
capabilities.prompt: Estimate the embodied carbon of the structure by material and level, with the factors you used.

capabilities.title: Compare two options
capabilities.prompt: Compare the embodied carbon of the current concrete slabs with a hollow-core alternative, as a short table.

capabilities.title: Carbon view
capabilities.prompt: Colour the 3D view by embodied carbon per element so the heavy parts stand out.

capabilities.title: Find by parameter
capabilities.prompt: Find all elements whose Mark is empty, grouped by category, with ids I can click.

capabilities.title: Bulk parameter update
capabilities.prompt: Set the Comments parameter of the selected elements to the value I give, and tell me how many changed.

capabilities.title: Coordinates
capabilities.prompt: Report the survey point, project base point and the shared coordinates of the selected element.

capabilities.title: Save as a recipe
capabilities.prompt: Save the steps you just did as a recipe I can run again on other models.

capabilities.title: Remember a standard
capabilities.prompt: Remember that our beams are always tagged with type mark and size, in every model.

capabilities.title: Worksets I hold
capabilities.prompt: List the worksets and elements I own and relinquish them.

capabilities.title: Purge unused content
capabilities.prompt: Preview a purge of everything unused in this model (families, types, materials, patterns, view templates and filters), keeping our title blocks. Show me the counts by kind before you delete anything.

capabilities.title: Tidy views and imports
capabilities.prompt: List the views that are on no sheet and the imported CAD in this model, keeping anything named WORKING or _keep. Show me the preview first, then delete them when I say so.

capabilities.title: Model health clean
capabilities.prompt: Run a model health clean preview: unused view templates, unplaced rooms and areas, unplaced groups and unused filters, and list the Revit warnings by type with how to fix the top ones.

tailored.title: Structural grid options
tailored.prompt: Propose two column grid options for this building from the architectural plans, with spans and a short pros and cons table.

tailored.title: Floor system comparison
tailored.prompt: Compare flat slab, beam and slab, and post-tensioned options for the typical floor: depth, self-weight and embodied carbon.

tailored.title: Stability strategy
tailored.prompt: Look at the cores and walls in the model and suggest a lateral stability strategy, marking walls that could act as shear walls.

tailored.title: Quick scheme model
tailored.prompt: Create levels from the architectural model and place indicative columns at grid intersections so we can see the scheme.

tailored.title: Early quantities
tailored.prompt: Give rough concrete and steel quantities for the scheme, by level, with assumptions stated.

tailored.title: Concept carbon
tailored.prompt: Estimate embodied carbon for the concept structure and name the three biggest contributors.

tailored.title: Column schedule set-up
tailored.prompt: Create a column schedule with mark, type, base and top level, and put it on a new sheet.

tailored.title: Transfer review
tailored.prompt: List columns and walls that don't continue down, with the elements they land on.

tailored.title: Slab openings
tailored.prompt: Find slab openings over 1 m and list them with level and size, for review with the architect.

tailored.title: Coordination with MEP
tailored.prompt: Check the linked MEP model for ducts crossing beams and list the clashes by level.

tailored.title: Schematic sheets
tailored.prompt: Make general arrangement plans for each level on sheets, with grids dimensioned.

tailored.title: Foundation scheme
tailored.prompt: Propose a pad or raft foundation layout under the columns, using the column loads I give.

tailored.title: Beam reinforcement
tailored.prompt: Reinforce the beams on the selected level from the attached design output and report any beam you couldn't match.

tailored.title: Tags and dimensions
tailored.prompt: Tag every structural element in the active views and dimension openings in walls and slabs.

tailored.title: Sections at cores
tailored.prompt: Create sections through each core and place them on a sheet with a key plan.

tailored.title: Penetrations
tailored.prompt: Create MEP openings in beams and walls where linked ducts and pipes cross them, with sleeves scheduled.

tailored.title: Typical details
tailored.prompt: Place the typical details sheet with our standard detail components.

tailored.title: Model check before review
tailored.prompt: Run the model check and the drawing check and give me a list of fixes before the design review.

tailored.title: IFC revision
tailored.prompt: Create the IFC revision, add it to all structural sheets, and update the revision schedule on each title block.

tailored.title: Export the IFC set
tailored.prompt: Export all S- sheets to PDF and the drawing list to Excel, in one folder named with today's date.

tailored.title: Bar schedules
tailored.prompt: Export the bar bending schedules for every reinforced element, one sheet per level.

tailored.title: Final drawing check
tailored.prompt: Check every sheet for untagged elements, missing dimensions and views not on sheets.

tailored.title: Clouds for changes
tailored.prompt: Cloud the elements changed since the last issue and tag the clouds with the revision.

tailored.title: Handover pack
tailored.prompt: Export the project pack for handover, with chats left out.

tailored.title: Berth layout
tailored.prompt: Set up the berth for the design vessel and show the clear water along the quay line.

tailored.title: Quay structure options
tailored.prompt: Compare an open piled deck with a gravity quay wall for this site: rough quantities and carbon.

tailored.title: Pile grid study
tailored.prompt: Lay out an indicative pile grid under the deck at two spacings and compare pile counts.

tailored.title: Mooring layout
tailored.prompt: Propose bollard and fender positions along the quay for the design vessel.

tailored.title: Concept levels
tailored.prompt: Create the deck, cope and seabed levels from the values I give, with grids along the quay.

tailored.title: Early carbon
tailored.prompt: Estimate embodied carbon of the quay concept and the share from piles, deck and furniture.

tailored.title: Deck framing
tailored.prompt: Model the deck beams and slab between the pile caps, using the cross-section I give.

tailored.title: Pile schedule
tailored.prompt: Create a pile schedule with mark, type, toe level and rake, and put it on a sheet.

tailored.title: Furniture spacing
tailored.prompt: Check the spacing of fenders and bollards and flag anything outside the range I give.

tailored.title: Vessel clearance
tailored.prompt: Check the design vessel against the quay structure and fenders for clashes.

tailored.title: Expansion joints
tailored.prompt: Suggest expansion joint positions along the deck for the given length and show them in plan.

tailored.title: Schematic sheets
tailored.prompt: Make plan and section sheets for the quay with grids and levels dimensioned.

tailored.title: Pile cap reinforcement
tailored.prompt: Reinforce the pile caps with the bar layout I give and export the bar schedule.

tailored.title: Deck sections
tailored.prompt: Create sections every 20 m along the quay and place them on sheets in order.

tailored.title: Embedded items
tailored.prompt: Place the embedded plates and sleeves for services along the deck and schedule them.

tailored.title: Tag and dimension the quay
tailored.prompt: Tag piles, beams and furniture in the plans and dimension pile positions from the grids.

tailored.title: Durability notes
tailored.prompt: Add general notes for cover and concrete grade for the marine exposure I give.

tailored.title: Detailed model check
tailored.prompt: Run the model audit and list missing marks, unjoined elements and piles without a toe level.

tailored.title: IFC revision
tailored.prompt: Create the IFC revision and add it to the quay drawings, then export them to PDF.

tailored.title: Pile setting-out
tailored.prompt: Export pile coordinates in site coordinates to Excel for the setting-out engineer.

tailored.title: Final schedules
tailored.prompt: Export the pile, bar and embedded item schedules for construction.

tailored.title: Construction sequence
tailored.prompt: Set up the construction sequence phases for piling, deck and furniture and colour a 3D view by phase.

tailored.title: Drawing list
tailored.prompt: Export the drawing list with revisions for the transmittal.

tailored.title: Handover pack
tailored.prompt: Export the project pack for handover, with the issued sheets listed.

tailored.title: Alignment and levels
tailored.prompt: Create levels and reference grids along the alignment from the coordinates I give.

tailored.title: Structure type study
tailored.prompt: Compare a culvert, a short-span bridge and a retaining wall option for this crossing: rough quantities and carbon.

tailored.title: Retaining wall scheme
tailored.prompt: Model an indicative retaining wall along the selected line with the height I give.

tailored.title: Site coordinates
tailored.prompt: Set the shared coordinates from the survey point I give and report the project base point.

tailored.title: Concept quantities
tailored.prompt: Give rough concrete and steel quantities for the concept, with assumptions stated.

tailored.title: Concept carbon
tailored.prompt: Estimate the embodied carbon of the concept and the biggest contributors.

tailored.title: Abutments and piers
tailored.prompt: Model abutments and piers at the stations I give, with indicative pile groups.

tailored.title: Deck framing
tailored.prompt: Place girders between the supports at the spacing I give and a deck slab over them.

tailored.title: Drainage openings
tailored.prompt: Find where the linked drainage crosses the structure and create openings with sleeves.

tailored.title: Sections along the alignment
tailored.prompt: Create sections at each support and place them on sheets in chainage order.

tailored.title: Schematic schedule
tailored.prompt: Create a schedule of structural elements by support with volumes.

tailored.title: Coordination check
tailored.prompt: Check the structure against the linked utilities and list the clashes by support.

tailored.title: Wall and footing reinforcement
tailored.prompt: Reinforce the retaining wall and its footing with the bar layout I give.

tailored.title: Bearing plinths
tailored.prompt: Model bearing plinths on the piers at the girder positions and dimension them.

tailored.title: Construction joints
tailored.prompt: Propose construction joint positions for the wall and show them in elevation.

tailored.title: Tag and dimension
tailored.prompt: Tag all structural elements and dimension supports from the reference grids.

tailored.title: Bar schedules
tailored.prompt: Export bar bending schedules by element for review.

tailored.title: Detailed model check
tailored.prompt: Run the model audit and list unjoined elements, missing marks and elements without materials.

tailored.title: IFC revision
tailored.prompt: Create the IFC revision, add it to all sheets and export them to PDF.

tailored.title: Setting-out data
tailored.prompt: Export the coordinates of supports and pile centres in site coordinates to Excel.

tailored.title: Final quantities
tailored.prompt: Export final concrete, reinforcement and steel quantities by element for the bill of quantities.

tailored.title: Sequence for construction
tailored.prompt: Set up construction phases and colour a 3D view by phase for the method statement.

tailored.title: Transmittal list
tailored.prompt: Export the drawing list with current revisions for the transmittal.

tailored.title: Handover pack
tailored.prompt: Export the project pack for handover.
